annotations.title: Get an upload link for a photo

description: For a photo file on the assistant's own machine: returns an uploadUrl. The file's bytes are PUT there with the returned headers within 10 minutes, and the uploadId then goes to add_listing_photos.

mimeType.description: The file type: image/jpeg, image/png, image/webp, image/heic or image/heif.

sha256.description: Optional: the file's SHA-256, lowercase hex.

size.description: The file's size in bytes (at most 25 MB).

name: request_photo_upload
